essence: Through the root mantra, the mantra-knower is not afflicted by any faults.
By oblations with palāśa flowers and similar rites, one quickly becomes a poet.
By muttering the mantra ten thousand times, one obtains greater prosperity.
One should mutter the mantra twenty thousand times while subsisting on alms-food.
When thus worshipped, the mantra grants both enjoyment and liberation.
